goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear and watch your plot grow, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy upgrades there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, opened the SHOP and bought many upgrades there (Dropper 2 and 3, Silver and Gold ore, Speed 1 and 2, Cash x1.5), and touched the Dropper 4 pad. It never reached the $10K rebirth cost, so no rebirth was shown. It also never looked at the TOP TYCOONS board and ended after 18 steps. Probe errors were empty, but the rebirth price is shown inconsistently and a rebirth press gives no clear feedback.

bugs.title: Rebirth price differs between altar and HUD button
bugs.evidence: The touchables list shows the altar label 'REBIRTH $5000 Next: x1.5' (steps 1-9), while RebirthGui.RebirthButton reads 'REBIRTH $10.0K (n%)' and the HUD says 'Need $6748 more...'. The two places disagree on the cost, so a new player cannot tell what rebirth costs.

bugs.title: Rebirth attempts give no clear 'not enough cash' feedback
bugs.evidence: Pressing RebirthButton at steps 4, 9 and 14 and triggering the altar prompt at step 7 produced only HUD text changes. The probe shows rebirth_denied=4 but the observations show no denial message. The altar press did not visibly do anything.

bugs.title: Probe shows rebirths=1 although no rebirth was observed
bugs.evidence: The final counters show rebirths:1, but all 4 rebirth attempts were denied (rebirth_denied:4) and cash never dropped. The playtester flagged rebirths=1 as early as step 1. The counter may be mis-incremented, or something else caused it.

bugs.title: Upgrade pads could not be touched after the same upgrades were bought in the SHOP
bugs.evidence: go_touch on UpgradePad_dropper3 (step 11) and UpgradePad_speed1 (step 13) returned done=False 'never touched', although cash was sufficient. Both upgrades had already been bought through the SHOP (steps 5-6). The pads may be removed or disabled after a shop purchase, which would be confusing for a new player, or they may be unreachable. This is unclear from the trace.

bugs.title: Shop purchases appear to succeed with very little cash and give no rejection feedback
bugs.evidence: At step 3 the playtester pressed Buy on Silver Ore expecting a rejection with about $10 cash. The next observation shows 'Upgraded: Silver Ore' and 'Ore: Silver'. It is unclear whether cash was deducted or the price check is wrong, and the playtester's cash figure may simply be out of date.
